cases.name: Charlotte Buskey
cases.narrative:
On April 14, 2024, first responders were summoned to Mr. Buskey’s Elmer Avenue residence for an unresponsive 5 year old girl. What they found when they entered was a house of horrors. The condition of the house was deplorable, the dining room area contained a makeshift cage in which Mr. Buskey’s 3 year old son was kept, and in Mr. Buskey’s bedroom was the emaciated body of a 5 year old little girl, his daughter Charlotte. Based upon the investigation in this case it was learned that Charlotte had been neglected and malnourished for months. She, along with her brother, had been closed off from the outside world. They no longer saw family, they were no longer attending doctor appointments, and they were not, nor had ever been, enrolled in school. Their world shrunk to the confines of Mr. Buskey’s deplorable home, and ultimately, for Charlotte, the confines of her bedroom in which Mr. Buskey kept her locked, and Jackson, in his cage, so Mr. Buskey could do drugs, play video games, and not be bothered by his children.  Mr. Buskey’s children did not even have the comfort of each other in the end. 

The evidence in this case revealed that Mr. Buskey actually installed a lock on the outside of Charlotte’s bedroom door and reinforced it with tape after he discovered that Charlotte was able to escape by jiggling the door.  Inside of the bedroom, she did not even have a bed, but rather a pack n play so small that she was forced to lie in a fetal position. That’s where Charlotte spent her final days, abandoned and locked in her room by her father. She had no food, no water, no contact with anyone, in a pack n play, left there to die, and she did. And she died in a house that was stocked with food, including boxes of food right outside of her locked bedroom.  Yet, when she was ultimately found, she was so dehydrated that her eyes were sunken into her skull and her body completely emaciated. Her autopsy revealed that not only was she in a state of severe dehydration, but her body was completely devoid of any food.

Along with the murder of his daughter, Mr. Buskey was also charged with sale of a narcotic drug. Under our law sale of a drug includes giving, which is what Mr. Buskey did to his children. Both children tested positive for cocaine.  In Court today, along with his plea of guilty to Murder, Mr. Buskey also pled guilty to giving a narcotic drug to his 3 year old son.
